LAAP • ALGEBRA 1 • MATH ADVENTURE
MR. HOWARD'S
INEQUALITY QUEST

The world has been taken over by the Inequality Forces. Mr. Howard must travel through 10 worlds, defeat math enemies, master inequality graphs, and restore balance. Every correct answer powers his next attack.

🎮 10 Levels

Difficulty rises from one-step inequalities to compound and mixed forms.

⚔️ 2-Hit Enemies

First solve the inequality. Then match its graph.

👑 Boss Battles

Each boss takes 5 correct hits. The final hit triggers a power beam.

🪙 Coin Store

Spend coins on extra lives and math-assist power-ups between levels.
